description: Header file defining classes and methods for writing XML elements, including XmlAttributes and XmlElementWriter, with support for nested elements and attribute handling.

classes.name: XmlAttributes
classes.description: A vector of XML attribute key-value pairs with methods to add attributes.

classes.name: XmlElementWriter
classes.description: Helper class for writing XML elements with support for nested elements and formatting.

methods.name: XmlAttributes(std::string_view attr_key, std::string_view attr_value)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a single attribute.

methods.name: add(std::string_view attr_key, std::string_view attr_value)
methods.description: Method to add an attribute to XmlAttributes.

methods.name: XmlElementWriter(std::ostream& out, const std::string& tag, const XmlAttributes& attributes)
methods.description: Constructor for root XML element with no indentation.

methods.name: XmlElementWriter(std::ostream& out, const std::string& tag, const XmlAttributes& attributes, int indent)
methods.description: Constructor for XML element with specified indentation.

methods.description: Template constructor for XML element with a single attribute without copying attribute value.

methods.description: Destructor that ends the XML element.

methods.description: Method to write arbitrary XML text content.
